title: Land-use change detection and assessment for sustainable development of peri-urban areas using remote sensing and GIS: Coimbatore City, Tamil Nadu
abstract: Uses Landsat-derived LULC analysis and an ANN-based GIS change-modeller to measure built-up area growth in Coimbatore's peri-urban zones across 1997, 2009 and 2017, projecting growth to 2030/2040.

title: Urban Development in the Western Part of Tamil Nadu (Kongu Nadu Region): A Temporal Study Using LULC Change Detection Analysis
abstract: Examines urban expansion in the Kongu Nadu region (western TN) from 1985-2024 using multi-source satellite imagery, tracking impacts on agriculture, forest cover, and water bodies.

title: Analysis of land use/land cover changes using geospatial techniques in Salem district, Tamil Nadu, South India
abstract: Uses Landsat TM/OLI imagery (1992-2015) and supervised maximum-likelihood classification to quantify LULC dynamics and agricultural/water-body loss in Salem district.

title: A study of urban heat island effects using remote sensing and GIS techniques in Kancheepuram, Tamil Nadu, India
abstract: Analyzes Land Surface Temperature distribution in Kancheepuram district using Landsat imagery (1988 vs 2021) and NDVI classification, linking land-use change to urban heat island intensification.

title: Land-use/cover change in Coimbatore urban area (Tamil Nadu, India) — a remote sensing and GIS-based study
abstract: Explains LULC change in Coimbatore City Corporation using Landsat ETM+/OLI, finding significant built-up area increase over 11 years and recommending green-infrastructure planning.

title: Long-term land use and land cover change detection and prediction using remote sensing and ML approaches (1995-2035) for Gudalur Taluk, Tamil Nadu
abstract: Applies a CA-Markov hybrid model with GIS methods to evaluate LULC changes 1994-2024 in Gudalur Taluk (Nilgiris) and forecast trends for 2034-2044.

title: Land use/land cover change detection through remote sensing and GIS technology — St. Thomas Mount Block, Kancheepuram District, Tamil Nadu
authors: R. Muruganandam, K. Kumaraswamy, K. Rudhravel Murthy
abstract: Compares LULC across 1973, 1991 and 2006 near Chennai, finding rapid built-up expansion and declining agricultural/forest land as urbanization spreads outward from Chennai.

title: A decadal study on land use and land cover change detection along the coastal regions of Cuddalore and Nagapattinam districts of Tamil Nadu
abstract: Assesses LULC change (2000-2021) along the Cuddalore/Nagapattinam coast, linking built-up expansion and forest/mangrove change to coastal economic development.

title: Study Report on Quality of Land Records in Tamil Nadu
abstract: Field-based assessment of DILRMP implementation in Tamil Nadu, covering the 'Tamil Nilam' portal, taluk-level computerization progress, and remaining gaps (Aadhaar authentication, citizen awareness).

title: Challenges and improvements on digitalization of land records (India)
authors: School of Law, Joy University, Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu
abstract: Legal-studies perspective on India's digital land records initiative, examining accuracy, security and access improvements, with reference to Tamil Nadu.

title: Land use/land cover changes of Noyyal watershed in Coimbatore district, India, mapped using remote sensing techniques
abstract: Produces LULC maps and change-detection analysis of the Noyyal watershed (Coimbatore) over an 18-year period using remote sensing and GIS.

title: Assessment of Land Use/Land Cover Changes in Noyyal River Basin, Tamil Nadu, India: A case study using Geospatial techniques
abstract: Change-detection analysis (2001-2018) of built-up, agricultural, water body and forest land in the Noyyal river basin using visual interpretation of satellite imagery.

title: Environmental Impact Assessment on Noyyal River Basin, Special Reference to Water Quality
abstract: EIA case study of the Noyyal river basin (Coimbatore, Erode, Karur districts), examining industrial effluent impact on water quality from textile/dyeing industries around Tiruppur.

title: Investigating the impact of land use land cover change on groundwater level dynamics in the Koraiyar watershed, Coimbatore District, Tamil Nadu, India
authors: Naik SRS, Masilamani P, Kushawaha J, Jahangeer J
abstract: Uses LISS-III/IV and Landsat-8 OLI imagery (2000, 2011, 2020) to link LULC change to declining groundwater levels and wet-crop area loss in the Koraiyar watershed, Coimbatore.

title: Groundwater Storage and Depletion Trends in Tamil Nadu State, India
abstract: Uses NASA GRACE satellite gravimetry and GLDAS data (2002-2012) to quantify statewide groundwater depletion in Tamil Nadu at 21.4 km3/yr, exceeding the annual recharge rate by 8%.

title: Groundwater sustainability indicators in parts of Tiruppur and Coimbatore districts, Tamil Nadu
abstract: Develops groundwater sustainability indicators for Tiruppur and Coimbatore districts, relevant to assessing agricultural vs. industrial water-use tradeoffs in the region.

title: Land Use and Land Cover Changes and Its Implications on Groundwater Quality in Perambalur District, Tamil Nadu
abstract: Analyzes LULC dynamics along national/state highways in Perambalur/Tiruchirappalli region (1995-2025 projected) and their implications for groundwater quality.

title: Assessing Groundwater Depletion in Southern India as a Function of Urbanization and Change in Hydrology: A Threat to Tank Irrigation in Madurai City
abstract: Shows surface runoff reaching 86% of rainfall in urbanized Madurai vs ~70% in rural areas, and declining discharge into traditional irrigation tanks due to urbanization and erratic rainfall.

title: Spatiotemporal assessment and simulation of land use and land cover dynamics in coastal Tamil Nadu using CA-ANN modelling for sustainable development planning
abstract: Projects built-up area growth of over 154% (2017-2053) in coastal delta taluks of Tamil Nadu using Sentinel-2 data and a CA-ANN model, with accuracy validated 88-92% via Kappa statistics; also flags limitations of NDVI-based ecological assessment.
